name: The Dubai EDITION
insider_take: Where cutting-edge design meets Dubai's cosmopolitan energy in the heart of Downtown's most coveted address.
whats_special: This is Ian Schrager's first Middle Eastern property, featuring his signature minimalist luxury aesthetic just steps from the Burj Khalifa. The hotel's stunning infinity pool on the 20th floor offers unobstructed views of the world's tallest building, while the ground-floor Market restaurant serves globally-inspired cuisine in a theatrical open-kitchen setting.
pro_tip: Book a Burj Khalifa view room and time your arrival for sunset – the golden hour light reflecting off the tower creates an Instagram-worthy moment that's pure Dubai magic.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar Sanderson offers craft cocktails with panoramic city views, while the hotel's prime location puts you within walking distance of The Dubai Mall's 1,200 shops, the mesmerizing Dubai Fountain shows, and the historic Al Fahidi neighborhood's traditional wind towers and spice souks.
pros: Ultra-modern design with sophisticated Ian Schrager aesthetic
Prime Downtown Dubai location with Burj Khalifa views
Exclusive rooftop bar and dining experiences
Marriott STARS Program benefits and elite service
cons: Contemporary minimalist style may not suit all preferences
